intent.name: Intent
intent.ja: Intent（意図）— ユーザーが本当にやりたいこと。明示的（声に出す）と暗黙的（状況から推論）の2種類。
intent.en: Intent — what the user actually wants. Can be explicit (declared) or implicit (inferred from Token × Brain intersection).
intent.short: What the user actually wants. Can be explicit (declared) or implicit (inferred from Token × Brain intersection).
intent.metaphor: The order, before the order. 'A simple, warm, autumnal evening' — what every later choice serves.

context-grammar.name: Context Grammar
context-grammar.ja: Context Grammar — AIが「今のあなた」を理解し、状況に適応したUIを生成するための設計言語。
context-grammar.en: Context Grammar — a design language for the layer where intent becomes interface. Eight Tokens, a three-layer Brain, two Dials, a Rule Engine.
context-grammar.short: A design language for the layer where intent becomes interface. Eight Tokens, a three-layer Brain, two Dials, a Rule Engine.
context-grammar.metaphor: The way a great restaurant operates without asking — what each guest needs is read, not requested.

context-token.name: Context Tokens
context-token.ja: Context Token — 「今どういう状況か」を構造化する8つの次元。6つの状況Token + 2つの関係Dial。
context-token.en: Context Tokens — eight live signals that feed the Now Layer. Six situation tokens (Physical State, Cognitive Load, Social Exposure, Priority Weight, Form Factor, Feasibility) plus two relationship dials (Autonomy, Disclosure).
context-token.short: Eight live signals that feed the Now Layer — six situation tokens plus two relationship dials.
context-token.metaphor: The waiter reading the table — what they see, what they hear, what posture the diners are in — before deciding how to approach.

physical-state.name: Physical State
physical-state.ja: ① Physical State — 体が今どういう状態か。片手、歩行中、運転中など。UIの基本的な形が変わる。
physical-state.en: Physical State — body and device posture. Driving, hands full, baby on hip, walking, seated, standing on a moving train.
physical-state.short: Body and device posture. Driving, hands full, baby on hip, standing on a moving train.
physical-state.metaphor: The waiter notices the guest is holding a baby and quietly slides the steak knife to their other side.

cognitive-load.name: Cognitive Load
cognitive-load.ja: ② Cognitive Load — 頭にどのくらい余裕があるか。推定ベース（時間帯×カレンダー密度×直近の活動）。
cognitive-load.en: Cognitive Load — how much attention is available. Estimated from time of day × calendar density × recent activity. Not directly measured.
cognitive-load.short: How much attention is available. Estimated from time of day × calendar density × recent activity. Not directly measured.
cognitive-load.metaphor: The waiter senses the table is mid-argument and waits, instead of cheerfully reciting the specials.

social-exposure.name: Social Exposure
social-exposure.ja: ③ Social Exposure — 誰が画面を見ているか。子供がいれば価格を隠す。上司がいれば数字を隠す。
social-exposure.en: Social Exposure — who might see or hear this. Alone, with family, in public, screen-shared.
social-exposure.short: Who might see or hear this. Alone, with family, in public, or screen-shared.
social-exposure.metaphor: The waiter brings the surprise gift box but sees the recipient is at the table, walks past, comes back later.

priority-weight.name: Priority Weight
priority-weight.ja: ④ Priority Weight — 複数の要求がぶつかったとき、何が先か。衝突解決のToken。
priority-weight.en: Priority Weight — current urgency plus learned tradeoffs. Resolves collisions when demands compete.
priority-weight.short: Current urgency plus learned tradeoffs. Resolves collisions when demands compete — not just 'what's most important' but 'what gives way to what.'
priority-weight.metaphor: The kitchen knows that on a Friday, table 7's anniversary cake comes out before table 4's appetizer refire.

form-factor.name: Form Factor
form-factor.ja: ⑤ Form Factor — 周りにどんな画面があるか。スマホ→TV追加でUIの役割が変わる。
form-factor.en: Form Factor — what surface is receiving — phone, car, TV, fridge, watch, earbuds. Each has its own native vocabulary.
form-factor.short: What surface is receiving — phone, car, TV, fridge, watch, earbuds. Each has its own native vocabulary.
form-factor.metaphor: Every table has its own etiquette. The chef's counter speaks technique. The family booth speaks portion size. Forcing one onto the other is a design failure.

feasibility.name: Feasibility
feasibility.ja: ⑥ Feasibility — 実際に今できることは何か。在庫、天気、予算、時間の現実制約フィルター。
feasibility.en: Feasibility — can this actually happen right now. Stock on hand, time left, battery, network, who's available.
feasibility.short: Can this actually happen right now. Stock on hand, time left, battery, network.
feasibility.metaphor: The kitchen runs out of duck mid-service. Saying 'yes' is a lie; the right answer is 'here are three things we can still do beautifully.'

autonomy-dial.name: Autonomy Dial
autonomy-dial.ja: ⑦ Autonomy Dial — AIにどれだけ任せるか。Suggest→Confirm→Notify→Autoの4段階。3つの力（サービスの初期値×AIの調整×ユーザーの意思）で動く。
autonomy-dial.en: Autonomy Dial — how far you let AI act on your behalf in this domain. Four stages: Suggest → Confirm → Notify → Auto. Driven by three forces: service default × AI adjustment × user override.
autonomy-dial.short: How far you let AI act on your behalf. Four stages: Suggest → Confirm → Notify → Auto. Driven by three forces: service default × AI adjustment × user override. Not a single setting.
autonomy-dial.metaphor: The maître d' lets the sommelier choose pairings on their own (Auto) but asks the chef before changing the protein (Confirm). Same kitchen, different dials.

disclosure-dial.name: Disclosure Dial
disclosure-dial.ja: ⑧ Disclosure Dial — AIにどこまで知らせるか。ドメインごと、人ごと。Autonomyの前提条件 — 知らせないものは任せられない。
disclosure-dial.en: Disclosure Dial — how much the AI gets to know about you, per domain, per person. Prerequisite for Autonomy — 'don't know × do it for me' is logically impossible.
disclosure-dial.short: How much the AI gets to know about you, per domain, per person. Prerequisite for Autonomy — 'don't know × do it for me' is logically impossible.
disclosure-dial.metaphor: What you tell the waiter at the door: 'we have an allergy, and it's our anniversary.' That permission is what lets them act later without asking.

brain.name: Context Brain
brain.ja: Context Brain — AIの記憶。3層構造: Identity Layer（不変）/ Learning Layer（蓄積）/ Now Layer（今この瞬間）。
brain.en: Context Brain — the system that remembers on your behalf. Three layers: Identity (rarely changes), Learning (patterns over time), Now (live signals).
brain.short: The system that remembers on your behalf — not to store, but to act in this exact moment. Three layers: Identity, Learning, Now.
brain.metaphor: The whole of a restaurant's memory — the reservation book, the waiter's experience, and what they see in the room right now, all at once.

home-brain.name: Home Brain
home-brain.ja: Home Brain — 家庭の常駐記憶。家族の好み、アレルギー、行動パターンを年単位で蓄積し続ける。子供の宿題や旅行のDisposable Brainは、終わるとここに学びを返す。
home-brain.en: Home Brain — the permanent Brain for a household. Persistent across years. Children's Disposable Brains return their learnings to it when they dissolve.
home-brain.short: The permanent Brain for a household. Persistent across years. Disposable Brains return their learnings here when they dissolve.
home-brain.metaphor: The house's memory. Pop-up restaurants come and go inside it; the house keeps what mattered.

disposable-brain.name: Disposable Brain
disposable-brain.ja: Disposable Brain — 使い捨ての一時記憶。買い物や旅行のためにHome Brainから生まれ、終了後に学びだけ還元して消える。
disposable-brain.en: Disposable Brain — a temporary Brain spawned for a finite purpose (a trip, a move, a project). Lifecycle: Birth → Learn → Return → Dissolve.
disposable-brain.short: A temporary Brain spawned for a finite purpose. Lifecycle: Birth → Learn → Return → Dissolve. Returns its learnings to the Home Brain when done.
disposable-brain.metaphor: A birthday-party plan. Decorations, custom menu, extra staff — only for that night. When it ends, the decorations come down. But 'this guest held a party here' stays in memory.

translation-layer.name: Translation Layer
translation-layer.ja: Translation Layer — ユーザーの曖昧な言葉を、AIが理解できる構造化された検索条件に翻訳する層。
translation-layer.en: Translation Layer — translates the user's vague words into structured criteria the AI can act on.
translation-layer.short: Translates the user's vague words into structured criteria the AI can act on.
translation-layer.metaphor: The maître d' takes 'something light, my wife is tired' and turns it into a ticket the kitchen can cook from.

rule-engine.name: Rule Engine
rule-engine.ja: Rule Engine — Token × Brain → 設計ルールに変換するエンジン。UIの具体的な形を決定する。
rule-engine.en: Rule Engine — transforms tokens into design rules. Input: {Cognitive Load: high, Physical State: hands-busy, Form Factor: phone}. Output: 'one option, voice confirmation, no multi-tap flows.'
rule-engine.short: Transforms tokens into design rules. Input: tokens; output: a specific UI shape. The engine that makes context actionable.
rule-engine.metaphor: The kitchen's playbook: 'hands busy, no time → fire one dish, no decisions, plate it ready-to-eat.'

confidence-signal.name: Confidence Signal
confidence-signal.ja: Confidence Signal — AIの確信度。94%なら信頼できる、67%なら要確認。透明性の根拠。
confidence-signal.en: Confidence Signal — AI's certainty level surfaced to the user. 94% = trustworthy; 67% = needs verification.
confidence-signal.short: AI's certainty level surfaced to the user. The basis for trust calibration.
confidence-signal.metaphor: The chef pauses at the pass: 'I'm 90% sure this is right — taste it before it leaves the kitchen.'

dynamic-friction.name: Dynamic Friction
dynamic-friction.ja: Dynamic Friction — 摩擦は固定値ではない。文脈が決める。駅では低摩擦、購入時は高摩擦。
dynamic-friction.en: Dynamic Friction — friction is not a fixed value. Context determines it. Low at the platform, high at the purchase.
dynamic-friction.short: Friction isn't fixed. Context determines it — low when reviewing on a train, high when committing money.
dynamic-friction.metaphor: The bouncer is friendly to the regulars walking in but checks the ID of anyone heading near the cash drawer.

social-aware-filtering.name: Social-Aware Filtering
social-aware-filtering.ja: Social-Aware Filtering — 場にいる人間に応じて情報を自動フィルタリング。価格、年齢制限、ネタバレなどを自動で隠す。
social-aware-filtering.en: Social-Aware Filtering — auto-filter information based on who's present in the room or on the cast surface.
social-aware-filtering.short: Auto-filter information based on who's present. Hide prices on the family TV. Hide spoilers when kids walk in. Hide salary numbers when screen-sharing.
social-aware-filtering.metaphor: The waiter sees the surprise gift box on the table and quietly walks past — the gift survives the moment.

temporal-arc.name: Temporal Arc
temporal-arc.ja: Temporal Arc — 信頼が時間とともに育つ設計パターン。Week 1のSuggestがMonth 3のAuto に育つ。
temporal-arc.en: Temporal Arc — trust evolves over time. Week 1 Suggest grows into Month 3 Auto.
temporal-arc.short: Trust evolves over time, per domain. Week 1 Suggest grows into Month 3 Auto. Designs for the months, not the moment.
temporal-arc.metaphor: A new hire starts with every shift checked. Six months in, the chef stops checking the same dishes.

project-master-brain.name: Project Master Brain (PMB)
project-master-brain.ja: Project Master Brain (PMB) — プロジェクト群を統括する司令塔。Research Brain × Brand Brain × Org Brain × 過去の事例を読み、何を始める／止める／殺すかをPOに提案するが、決して自動決定はしない。
project-master-brain.en: Project Master Brain — the orchestrator. Reads Research × Brand × Org capacity × past project patterns; supports the PO in deciding what to start, hold, or kill. Never auto-decides.
project-master-brain.short: The orchestrator. Reads Research × Brand × Org capacity × past project patterns; helps the PO decide what to start, hold, or kill. Never auto-decides.
project-master-brain.metaphor: The maître d' who reads the night, the kitchen's load, the regulars about to walk in — and recommends which tables to seat next. The host still says yes.

intent-match.name: Intent Match
intent-match.ja: Intent Match — 現在の作業がスタート時の Intent からどれだけずれていないかを測る指標。スコアが下がったら品質警告ではなく、忠実度の警告として浮上する。
intent-match.en: Intent Match — a drift-detection metric. Measures how closely the current draft, output, or decision still matches the original Intent that started the work. A low score is a fidelity warning, not a quality warning.
intent-match.short: A drift-detection metric. How closely the current work still matches the original Intent. A low score is a fidelity warning, not a quality warning.
intent-match.metaphor: The chef tastes mid-cook: 'is this still what the guest asked for?' If the dish has drifted toward something else — louder, sweeter, heavier — that's a fidelity warning.

approval-gate.name: Approval Gate
approval-gate.ja: Approval Gate — AIが下書き、人間が一拍で承認。Autonomy = Confirm のときに使う。重要な企業アクションは必ずここを通す。
approval-gate.en: Approval Gate — AI drafts, human approves with one tap. Used when Autonomy = Confirm. Every consequential enterprise action passes through one.
approval-gate.short: AI drafts; the human approves with one tap. Used when Autonomy = Confirm. The pattern that keeps accountability with the human while the AI does the work.
approval-gate.metaphor: The chef plates the dish but waits at the pass for the head chef to nod before it goes out. The work is done; the call is made by someone with skin in it.

graduated-archive.name: Graduated Archive
graduated-archive.ja: Graduated Archive — 記憶はカレンダーではなくライフイベントに連動して開封される。「あなたが必要な瞬間」に浮上する。
graduated-archive.en: Graduated Archive — memories unlock on a schedule tied to life events, not calendar dates. The system surfaces something at the moment it matters.
graduated-archive.short: An AX Pattern: memories unlock on life events, not calendar dates. Resurfaced at the moment it matters, not when it was filed.
graduated-archive.metaphor: The chef's notebook of past anniversary dishes — only resurfaced on the right date, not searched for daily.
